summary: Plugin name controls marketing brand, skill name: field controls invocation prefix. Set independently — goodplan for plugin, gp: for skill prefixes via build-time injection.
Declaring hooks in plugin.json causes duplicate error. Auto-discovery at hooks/hooks.json is sufficient.
Plugin users don't have gp on PATH. All skill CLI references must use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/binaries/macos-arm64/gp.
GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch only works via API when workflow YAML exists on the default branch. Feature branch workflows use tag-based triggers.
Post-build assertion enforces package.json must be bumped before tagging. Test tags with suffixes deliberately fail.
History cleanup (238M to 36M) required force-push and re-release. Establish .gitignore early and audit before going public.
